notes: Three things for the quote. Vision Mixing on the quote now reads Vision Mixing - Fraser Hawkshaw, so a client reading it can tell that role is you and not the hired vision mixer priced underneath it. Your signature title can be set per job: a new box under Sign-off, My title on this job - type IMAG Director and Vision Mixer for a job where that is the role, and leave it blank on every other job to keep whatever Settings says. It applies to the signature on every email for that job and to the On The Day line in the crew email. And every extra charge now has a description box under it, the same as the service descriptions, so a charge can explain itself on the quote instead of being a bare line and a number. One line per point.
